title: Public Alert No. 02/2026– Alert on Revalidated and Unregistered Natrilix SR Found on Sale
summary: NAFDAC warns that revalidated and unregistered Natrilix SR (Indapamide 1.5mg) is on sale in Nigeria. Batch 32417 had its expiry altered from 03/2025 to 03/2026; batch 34934 is parallel-imported with no NAFDAC registration number. Both pose safety and potency risks.
